category: Fast, tiny JSON tree viewer for Svelte 5 — a runes-native port of react-json-view-lite with SSR-safe ids, snippet overrides, and zero runtime dependencies

repo_triage._comment: Public repo — GITHUB_TOKEN raises rate limits; public-read fallback works without it. Surfaces open PRs/issues NOT opened by github_handle, and threads awaiting your reply since the previous last_run.

self_features: Tiny, fast read-only JSON tree viewer; zero runtime dependencies
Svelte 5 runes-native with snippet overrides for custom rendering
API parity with react-json-view-lite for easy cross-framework migration
Small display surface — drops into a page, not a full editor
non_goals: JSON editing / schema validation (this is a viewer, not an editor — svelte-jsoneditor's domain)
A framework-agnostic build (it's a Svelte 5 component; vanilla-jsoneditor covers agnostic use)

competitors.note: Direct Svelte 5 runes-native read-only rival. Both have CSS variables and zero runtime dependencies; compare typed snippets, ARIA tree navigation, expansion callbacks, and its standalone JS bundle.
The dominant Svelte JSON tool, but a full editor (edit/validate/schema); heavier. We win on tiny read-only display + Svelte 5 + snippets.
Framework-agnostic build of the same editor; /compare rival for 'json viewer' intent.

watchlist.note: React-only comparison-page and search competitor; track dormancy and factual claims, not as a Svelte substitute.
High-traffic React-only viewer; watch for a stable 2.0 release and comparison-page claim drift.
React-only comparison-page and search competitor; monitor release activity and dormancy framing.

upstream.note: The React library this is a port of. Watch releases — new features/props upstream are candidates to port for API parity (same pattern as svelte-motion ← framer-motion).
